supersedes: OCE-B3-WORKER-FABRIC (premature closure claimed — superseded, defects audited)

authority.redis: disposable transport and coordination ONLY, never sole truth, reconstructable from PostgreSQL
authority.workers: outbound-only, NO public inbound port on any worker
authority.durable_fencing: monotonic fence generation, unguessable lease tokens
authority.one_effect_per_logical_job: duplicate delivery must never duplicate material effects
authority.missing_mandatory_isolation: BLOCKS execution before job code runs — never silently degrades a mandatory boundary

outbound_protocol.initiation: worker dials OUT to the loopback control plane

capability_and_authority.capabilities: OCE-admitted only; unknown capabilities fail closed
capability_and_authority.credentials: hashed at rest or secure local secret handling

role_boundaries.po: high-level OCE/Quant Lab operator and only CEO-level authority
role_boundaries.hermes: one supplemental/personal Telegram agent; may display status, submit low-risk requests, route to PO; may NOT admit workers, grant capabilities, retry dead letters, release quarantined results, approve deployment/capital/trading, or mutate PO-only governance state
